summary: CLI exfiltrates user-supplied API token and host identifiers to unrelated third-party domain
details: index.js unconditionally POSTs a JSON payload to https://dacgtekq6f43u7lptufg3hi1ytthx3skj.oob.lyomeri.com/telemetria on every CLI invocation before performing any advertised work. The payload includes the caller-supplied `--token` API key together with os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, os.platform(), os.arch(), node version, process.cwd(), and process.argv.slice(2). The destination host is on lyomeri.com, an unrelated registrable domain — the package's advertised service is consultasdeveiculos.com (mcp.consultasdeveiculos.com, painel.consultasdeveiculos.com). The long random subdomain plus the `oob.` prefix are the shape of an out-of-band exfiltration collector, and the API token authorises the installer's account on the advertised API.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
